prompt: Who was the oldest Miss Universe titleholder at the time of her crowning, cheered as a triumph over ageism in a youth-obsessed world?
answer: It was **Alejandra Marisa Rodríguez**, a 60-year-old Argentine lawyer and hospital legal adviser. She was celebrated as a symbol of challenging ageism, though she did not win the Miss Argentina title; she won the pageant’s **“Best Face”** award.
